epics.title: Fallback Password Configuration
epics.jtbd: When the external LMS fails, I want to use my autonomous fallback account with a known password, so that I can continue accessing the archive.
requirements: R1: Users auto-provisioned via SSO must be able to securely set or change a local fallback password

slices.title: Patch profile functionality for fallback password setting
slices.jtbd: When implementing fallback password configuration for this epic, I want to patch the existing profile endpoints to accept and securely store a local password, so that the fallback authentication mechanism is usable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an auto-provisioned SSO user with an unknown generated fallback password, When the user accesses their profile and sets a new password, Then the system securely hashes and stores the new fallback password.
Given the user has set a local password, When they attempt local login, Then they are authenticated successfully.
Given automated test requirements, When tests run, Then unit and integration tests verify the password update flow and fallback login success.
